_comment: Known invalid SQL references, accepted so the gate can be enforced today. This list may only SHRINK: a new entry fails CI, and an entry that no longer occurs ALSO fails CI, so it gets deleted rather than lingering as a permanent amnesty. History: opened at 18 entries 2026-08-01; the 8 tod/parking-rates entries were fixed in the same PR (repointed onto dcp_setback_controls) and removed, leaving 10. drawdown_verify_audits removed 2026-09-04 -- migration 033 run against production (DQ-91, explicit user authorization), table now exists and was proven end-to-end (insert/read/delete round trip through the real functions), leaving 9.
_triage_method: Reachability traced by import/render graph, not assumed. Frontend: API route -> importing component -> is that component ever rendered in JSX. Python: module -> importer -> is it in the Dockerfile.python entrypoint graph (uvicorn services.compliance_api_server:app). Every table/column absence confirmed individually against information_schema on the live database.
